scope: Affected concepts, simultaneous rule premises, target/time/signature and unconnected-concept consistency; not global semantic proof.

checks.concepts: D,C,E,A are typed actual relations; PC is D and C, not consciousness, owner, report or feeling.
checks.quantifiers: C1 universal admission is inherited. C1-C3 quantify only over the 128 declared rows; H1 is OPEN on grounded actual instances.
checks.all_of: No IA conclusion is used without all three simultaneous premises on the same binding. R181 supplies no actual human or deployed-model instance.
checks.joint_satisfiability: Blocked directive closure, imposed movement and imagery routing have explicit witnesses. Alternative episodes are not simultaneous assignments.
checks.objects_time_signature: Online D/C/E during I differs from later A/report; imagery target differs from overt target; external upstream history may lie outside P/I/K.
checks.actuality_evidence: Installed role differs from tests and reports used as evidence. Model variables stipulate roles only in the toy.
checks.direction: Origin, movement, report, prediction match and control success do not entail named feeling. C1 transport does not choose the label.
checks.unconnected_concepts: Ownership, familiar mineness, conceptual I, autobiographical identity and numerical persistence are not inferred.
checks.joint_failure: Removing independently grounded target or closure membership blocks H1 application.
checks.direction_check: The result returns to experience-internal action structure; no certificate expansion, basal gate or publication pressure.
